_comment: Copy this to <slug>.json and fill it in. Files starting with _ are skipped by the builder. Every field marked REQUIRED must be real data pulled from the shop's Google Maps listing or a conversation with the owner. Never invent a phone number, address, or review.
slug: REQUIRED - url-safe folder name, lowercase, no spaces
name: REQUIRED - exact business name as it appears on Google Maps
phone: REQUIRED - any format, the builder normalizes it
domain: example.com - leave empty until the domain is bought. Omitting it drops canonical, og:url, sitemap and robots.
theme: steel | pine | clay | ice - vary this between shops in the same town so they do not look like the same template
schema_type: AutoRepair | MotorcycleRepair | Store | LocalBusiness - see schema.org, AutoRepair is the safe default for a service shop
headline: The h1. Say what they do and where, in the owner's words if you have them. Not a slogan.
subhead: One sentence under the h1. Who they serve and what makes them different.
tagline: Short descriptor used in the page title, e.g. 'Motorcycle & ATV Repair'
seo_title: Optional override. Leave out and the builder composes name + tagline + city.

services.name: REQUIRED - at least 3 services or the page looks thin
services.desc: One or two plain sentences. What it is, who it is for.

about:
Two or three short paragraphs separated by a blank line.

Write it the way the owner talks. Specific beats polished. 'Been turning wrenches on sleds since high school' outperforms 'committed to excellence' every single time.

highlights.Small shop, direct answers: You talk to the person doing the work.
highlights.Straight pricing: You get the number before we start.

hours_note: Optional line under the table, e.g. seasonal hours.

address.street: Leave empty if unknown. A street address is the single biggest local SEO factor.

maps_url: Paste the shop's Google Maps link. Powers the directions buttons and hasMap schema.

reviews.text: Quote a real Google review verbatim. Do not edit it, do not write one.
reviews.author: First name L., Google

aggregate_rating._warning: Leave enabled false. Marking up Google's review scores as your own structured data violates Google's guidelines and can earn a manual action. value and count are still used for the on-page trust chip, which is fine.

cta_heading: Optional override for the closing section
